methodology.enumeration: Real spaces sourced from operator sites, Coworker.com, CoworkingCafe, Spaces/Regus & WeWork directories, cross-verified against a second source. Unknown attributes left null — never fabricated.
methodology.digitalScore: Live headless-Chromium render of each site (2026-06-21). 0-100 from real signals: reachable/200 (20), HTTPS (18), mobile viewport (18), title (8), meta description (8), Open Graph (6), social links up to 3 (12), booking CTA (10). Bot-protected pages flagged low-confidence, not scored as failing.
methodology.limits: This scores web PRESENCE (technical hygiene: HTTPS, mobile, SEO meta, social, booking), not the quality of the space itself — and it saturates, so several strong sites tie at 100. National chain locations (Regus/Spaces) score on their thin templated location page, not the brand's main site, so their identical C scores reflect the template, not the operator. Booking/social detection is heuristic and can miss non-standard widgets. Google ratings are sparse (not metered-API-pulled, to avoid cost). 3 independent domains did not resolve via DNS on scan day — flagged, not assumed closed. Coordinates are geocoded from addresses (some at neighborhood/city precision).
